messages:
miguel_oncall: incident-bot alerted me about sustained queue growth on customer-priv-vpc (acct: pharma-edge). GPU pool at 98% alloc, can't spin new nodes, autoscaler returning errors 'quota exceeded' + 'subnet-ip-limit'. paging oncall now :rotating_light:
incident-bot: [ALERT] autoscaler.failed_provisioning detected for pool 'priv-gpu-01' (threshold=120s). triggered pages: miguel_oncall, ivy_sre
miguel_oncall: I'm on the pager. quick check: are we hitting cloud account quotas or the customer's subnet being exhausted?
ivy_sre: seeing a ton of `NodeBootstrapFailed` with error `ENOSPACE: no available IPs in subnet` and `timed out waiting for kubelet` in the logs. looks like the customer's VPC ran out of /27 addresses.
ryan_platform: confirmed. autoscaler tried to create 6 nodes, API responses include 403 quota and 409 cidr-conflict in some calls. cloud console shows elastic IP pool saturated for that AZ.
olivia_eng: customer reported heavy batched inference job that spiked token throughput ~3x usual. they were pinned to the highest-capacity model variant, so each request uses larger KV cache and reduces packing efficiency.
sara_ops: contact with customer TPM: they're seeing 5-10s extra latency, and ~12% request errors (500s) for interactive routes. they flagged a high-priority incident and asked for ETA.
kevin_support: opening a support ticket linking the logs and current mitigation steps. I'm also putting together a timeline for the CSM.
ivy_sre: mitigation plan: 1) scale down to lower-memory model variant for affected routes (fast fallback) 2) manually hydrate a small set of spare nodes in a different AZ where IP capacity exists 3) update autoscaler config to allow staggered provisioning rather than all-at-once 4) coordinate with customer to free up IPs.
miguel_oncall: can we hotfix without touching customer's VPC? we need something that reduces queue pressure within our control.
ryan_platform: yes: route-level model fallback is controlled in our control plane. we can apply a routing policy to reduce batch sizes and prefer model-quantized variant `redwood/q2-thin-3b` which halves memory. that'll lower per-request GPU residency and free up KVC slots.
olivia_eng: pushing policy change now: `PATCH /routes/customer-pharma-edge/policies` with body `{ "prefer_model": "redwood/q2-thin-3b", "max_batch_tokens": 512 }`
incident-bot: deploy started by olivia_eng. CI check passed. applying to prod.
ivy_sre: also spinning up two manual nodes in AZ-b where IPs available. using `cloudctl instances create --zone az-b --count 2 --type gpu-nv4 --preemptible=false`

ivy_sre: logs from node bootstrap:
```
[bootstrap] attaching interface eth0 -> 10.0.3.254
[kubelet] waiting for kubelet to be ready
[kubelet] error: CNI failed: no available IPs in range
[autoscaler] retrying provisioning (attempt 3/5)
```

miguel_oncall: autoscaler config excerpt shows aggressive parallel provisioning: `max_parallel_provision: 10` and `provision_timeout_s: 300`. For constrained networks, that causes many simultaneous IP allocations -> race and exhaustion. propose reducing to `max_parallel_provision: 2` and increase `backoff_base_s: 30` to smooth out requests.
ryan_platform: agree. also add logic to detect `ENOSPACE` and switch to AZ fallback earlier. filing a quick PR to runtime-autoscaler to add `on_error: fallback_az` rule.

olivia_eng: customer route policy applied. initial metrics: queue depth down 40%, GPU allocation down to 88% in 3m. tail latency for chat route dropped from 4.6s -> 2.1s. error-rate down from 12% -> 3% for the routed paths.
sara_ops: customer on call says their blocking workflow is recovering. they still see occasional spikes when their batch jobs run. asking for ETA on full remediation and root cause.
kevin_support: ETA: manual node hydration in AZ-b will be up in ~8 minutes. autoscaler PR to land in 20-30m and roll out to canary cluster first. routing policy rollback is reversible if it causes quality regressions.
ivy_sre: chasing additional mitigations: reduce container image size to speed bootstrap (we can short-circuit image pull by using warmed cache images on the node template), and enable local IP reuse where supported. also notified infra to reserve an extra /28 for that customer's account as a temporary quota bump.
miguel_oncall: handing off to ivy_sre for sustained mitigation and RC (root cause) writeup. I'm staying as secondary oncall for followups.
ivy_sre: taking over. I'll coordinate with infra to confirm the temporary subnet reservation. also will collect the bootstrap traces and autoscaler metrics for the postmortem.
sara_ops: I'm drafting the customer-facing summary: impact window ~2026-03-15T10:12Z - ongoing (partial recovery). affected: interactive chat and some embed endpoints for acct pharma-edge. severity: P1 (customer-facing SLA risk). actions taken: route fallback, manual nodes in AZ-b, autoscaler config patch PR. next update in 15m.
incident-bot: page acknowledged by ivy_sre at 3827162000

ivy_sre: quick note - when we change routing to a lower-memory model, we should run a small quality check against their golden prompts. olivia_eng can you run an eval with 20 prompts and report delta?
olivia_eng: running eval now. initial diff: 0.6 ROUGE decrease on multi-turn pharmacology prompts, but response hallucination unchanged. customer ok with minor quality drop for now.
kevin_support: ticket #INC-4729 created and linked to timeline and logs. CSM notified.
miguel_oncall: status check: queue depth is stable, manual nodes healthy, autoscaler PR queued. handing incident to ivy_sre for postmortem. thanks all for fast coordination. :tada:

ivy_sre: will run postmortem and include: timeline, root cause (customer subnet IP exhaustion combined with aggressive parallel provisioning), mitigations (routing fallback, reserved subnet, autoscaler throttling), follow-ups (autoscaler logic to detect `ENOSPACE`, default backoff settings for private clusters, recommend route-level model variant guardrails for customers with small subnets).
sara_ops: noted. filing follow-ups for product: UI indicator for route-level model variant changes and cross-check with customer subnet sizes.
olivia_eng: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler/pull/914 (adds fallback_az on ENOSPACE + reduces default max_parallel_provision for private clusters)

ivy_sre: last check before I close this thread: all customer routes showing <5% errors, queue depth trending down, metrics look stable for 12m. I'll send final update when infra confirms subnet bump.
kevin_support: infra confirmed: reserved /28 allocated for customer account (temporary). requesting account team to approve permanent increase.
sara_ops: final customer update sent. they accepted the temporary mitigation and asked for a scheduled follow-up to discuss long-term subnet sizing.
miguel_oncall: closing my pager handoff. Good job team.
